title: harborpoint-diagnostics-onprem-call-ramble
content:
Call capture: Harborpoint Diagnostics — kickoff with IT + infra + compliance (2026-02-19). Short, messy notes for follow-ups and engineering handoff.

Attendees: Harborpoint: Jenna Morales (IT ops), Dr. Sameer Rao (Clinical AI/ML lead), Priya Singh (Security), Marco Liao (SRE). Redwood: Maya Patel (SE, owner), Ethan Kline (runtime), Sofia Ramos (privacy/compliance).

High-level ask: on-prem inference for triage assistant connected to Epic; strict PHI controls, air-gapped optionality for imaging metadata. Replace existing heuristic rules with LLM-based triage summaries; expect bursty traffic during shift changes.

Constraints called out by Harborpoint: 
- No egress of PHI; full on-prem with optional isolated control-plane VPN only.
- Must integrate with org KMS/HSM (Thales) for model keys and audit attestations.
- Audit logs retained 7 years (legal) — need guidance on log volume and retention cost.
- SLA: 99.95% uptime; 95th pct latency target for 512-token responses < 220ms for triage summaries.
- Throughput: typical steady QPS ~ 8 req/s, peak bursts up to 120 req/s during handoffs (10–15m windows). Average request size ~ 280 tokens in, response ~ 180–400 tokens depending on prompts.

Technical nuances and gotchas we surfaced: 
- Model choice: Harborpoint wants open/model-verified path. Recommend starting with a quantized llama-variant we have perf profile for (suggested: rwd-llama-13b-quant-8bit-prod-profile). Need to confirm clinical quality baseline — Dr. Rao will provide 150 labelled triage examples for initial eval.
- KV cache behavior: their workload has many repeated prefixes (patient header + recent notes). We recommended prefix caching + request routing to dedicated pool to avoid cache misses. If we fall back to hosted, must scrub PHI first — they refuse hosted for PHI.
- Tokenization gotcha: some of their imaging metadata includes long formatted headers causing token explosion; suggested prompt preprocessor to strip known structured fields (DICOM headers) before inference — Marco to send sample payloads.
- Network: Some labs are on segmented VLANs w/out NAT to internet. Onprem install must support air-gapped fetch for model artifacts (OCI tarball) and offline license verification. Create signed artifact transfer flow for support.
- Hardware footprint: initial sizing: 4 x A100-40GB nodes in dedicated pool with shared KV forwarding; estimate sustained 20–30% GPU utilization at steady QPS, 70–90% during peak. Ethan to run perf sim with histogram of sequence lengths once sample traces available.
- Cold-starts: first-request latency observed in other pilots (warmup of KV and kernel loading) — plan: pre-warm with a small scheduled synthetic traffic on canary hosts during shifts.
- Fallback policy: when dedicated capacity saturated, policy must fail closed for PHI flows (do not forward to hosted). For non-PHI mock flows (testing) we can route to hosted for capacity.

Compliance / privacy items: 
- Priya: must show dataflow diagram and threat model for legal review. She asked for explicit KMS integration doc + HSM attestation.
- Need to demonstrate removal of transient intermediate logs containing PHI from ephemeral storage; proposed approach: write logs to in-cluster encrypted store with lifecycle policy before offload to their SIEM.

Integration and product asks (practical):
- Provide a minimal runbook: install steps for air-gapped environment + checksum verification for model tarballs. (Action: Maya to draft and share by 2026-02-26).
- Template systemd/k8s YAML for onprem package; they run a mixed k8s (1.24) + baremetal for GPUs. Must support both modes (Action: Ethan to prototype YAML and systemd unit examples, 1 week).
- Quickstart eval harness: we need 150 labelled triage examples and 2 weeks of synthetic traffic traces. Dr. Rao will share dataset (Action: Dr. Rao by 2026-02-25).
- Observability: show per-request token-level cost, per-route latency histograms, and KV cache hit-rate metrics. Harborpoint wants alerting for cache drop below 85% and queue length > 60 for >30s.

Operational concerns:
- Runbook for emergency rollback to rule-based system (they have existing microservice returning legacy triage). Need a canary and instant fallback toggle in Console.
- Patch management: they require monthly security patch window; procurement lead needs upgrade notes and expected downtime.

Open questions (we did not get answers on call):
- Which legal entity will sign the private deployment agreement? (Procurement).
- Exact HSM API/version supported by their Thales box (Priya to confirm).
- Expected retention window for request/trace logs prior to SIEM transfer (they requested 7y but implementation may require intermediary TTL).

Next concrete steps and owners: 
- Maya: Draft air-gapped runbook + checklist (due 2026-02-26).
- Ethan: Perf simulation using sample token distribution (start after dataset receipt; target 2026-03-05).
- Sofia: Privacy checklist + recommended log retention architecture, include sample redaction config (due 2026-02-28).
- Harborpoint (Dr. Rao / Marco): Share 150 labelled triage examples + 72h of anonymized traffic traces + sample DICOM headers (due 2026-02-25).
- Joint: Schedule 90m technical deep dive to walk through artifact transfer, KMS, and HSM integration (tentative 2026-02-27).

Risks flagged for sales/CS: 
- Timeline risk if dataset delayed: PoC perf sims blocked.
- HSM incompatibility could force alternate key wrapping approach — could add 2–3 weeks.
- Log retention 7y may require storage sizing review — ask finance for cost estimate once we have QPS and average trace size.

Notes to self (rough):
- Keep PHI flows isolated; propose a second “shadow” non-PHI sandbox for feature dev.
- Consider quantization/mixed-precision testing early to hit latency SLOs without more GPUs.
- Add sample fallback policy templates: fail-closed PHI, fail-open non-PHI with rate cap.

Meeting artifacts to attach to final PoC folder: call recording link, sample payloads, dataset manifest, initial sizing calc, runbook draft.

Quick action: email procurement contact (Jenna) to request procurement template and PO lead contact.

-- end of raw notes.
